title: Eight hammer swings, one spot — the cracks now keep spreading
question: Read left to right, top to bottom: eight swings at the same place, one tile per swing. Swing 1 just cracks. Do the cracks visibly keep spreading, and by the last two tiles do you see a piece coming out along them as one lump (the pale polygon at his feet)? Is the pace right — should a block come away sooner, or later?
context_md:
Your playtest was right and my diagnosis was wrong: **three of every six blows were doing nothing at all.** The blow grew its cracked zone from a *count* of cracked cells — and a swing that works carries those cells out of the world as a piece, so the number fell exactly when the mechanic succeeded, and the front froze from swing 4 onward. It now reads how far the damage *reaches* instead, which calving cannot erase.

Hammer only in this strip — no pick, so nothing here is dug.
